Earlier batches covered stateful streaming pipelines that latch a sticky first error (tar `Writer`, `bufio.Scanner`, cmd/cgo, cmd/gofmt, vendored pprof `profile`); vendored files under `std/cmd/vendor/golang.org/x/` decoding low-level binary data with bit masking and strict error checking (arm64asm `GoSyntax`, riscv64asm `Decode`, sumdb `ClientOps`, sumdb/tlog, FreeBSD syscalls); machine-generated syscall wrappers and constant tables in `golang.org/x/sys/unix`; cgo-generated ztypes files; `norm/composition.go`'s `streamSafe`; the modernize analyzer's `stringscut.go`; `astutil/imports.go`; `rsc.io/markdown/inline.go`; five trust-boundary std files that all validate input and fail closed (bzip2 `StructuralError`/`NewReader`, gcm `NewGCM`/`gcmTagSize`, rsa constant-time ops with `rsa1024min=0` GODEBUG, tls `SessionState`, driver `Connector`/`Validator`/`SessionResetter`); five format parsers/serializers tracking explicit position with precise byte-offset errors (gosym `LineTable`, embed's `//go:embed`, `base64.Encoding`, gob, `json/scanner.go`); five semantic "meaning-making" files of the Go toolchain (`json/v2/doc.go`, `fmt/format.go`, `go/parser/resolver.go`, `go/types/check.go`, `go/types/object.go`); five files pushing structured data through fixed, invariant-preserving pipelines (`go/types/typeset.go`, `html/template/template.go` with its sticky `escapeErr`, `image/jpeg/dct.go` tracking QN.M fixed-point precision, `image/png/writer.go` latching `e.err`, `slog/doc.go`); and five performance-conscious primitives managing small bounded internal state (`math/big/natconv.go`, `math/bits/bits.go`, `math/rand/rng.go`'s 607-word ring register, `net/http/clientconn.go`'s `ClientConn`, `net/http/pprof/pprof.go`).

A later batch covered five standard-library adapters translating external identifiers or byte streams into internal representations by walking them with explicit bounds: `std/net/lookup_windows.go` (`winError`, `lookupProtocol` on a locked OS thread), `std/net/udpsock.go` (`UDPAddr`, `ResolveUDPAddr`), `std/os/file_windows.go` (the `file` struct wrapping `poll.FD`, `newFileKind`), `std/path/filepath/path.go` (`Separator`/`ListSeparator`, `Clean`), and `std/regexp/exec.go` (the NFA `machine` with `q0`/`q1`, pooled `thread`s, cached `inputs`). Bounds included a CNAME chain capped at 10 and `maxBitStateLen`; each wraps failures in a package-specific error type (`DNSError`, `OpError`, `PathError`/`LinkError`).

Another batch covered five `runtime` package files — the lowest-level layer managing the process's finite resources: `std/runtime/extern.go` (`GOGC` default 100, `GOMEMLIMIT` soft limit, start of `GODEBUG` docs), `std/runtime/malloc_stubs.go` (stubs specialized by `_mkmalloc`, `nextFreeFastStub`), `std/runtime/mfinal.go` (`finBlockSize = 4*1024`, `finBlock`, `fingStatus` atomics), `std/runtime/mranges.go` (`addrRange` never spanning a gap, `makeAddrRange` throwing on mismatch), and `std/runtime/os3_solaris.go` (`//go:cgo_export_dynamic`/`//go:cgo_import_dynamic`). Each maintains strict self-checking invariants over unsafe pointer arithmetic, with `throw` on violation.

A following batch of five `runtime` and codegen files covered: `std/runtime/race.go` (race detector API under the `race` tag, `//go:linkname`ed `//go:nosplit` shims, happens-before by analogy to C11); `std/runtime/sema.go` (Plan 9-style semaphore with `semaRoot` treap, `semTable` of `semTabSize = 251` entries); `std/runtime/stubs.go` (assembly intrinsics `add`, `getg`, `mcall`, `systemstack`, plus a linkname "hall of shame"); `std/runtime/syscall_windows.go` (Windows callback registration: `cbs`, `cb_max`, `winCallback` with `abiMap`, `abiPart` with `tryMerge`); and `std/simd/archsimd/_gen/unify/env.go` (codegen helper `envSet` over a commutative, idempotent semiring with disjoint-binding joins). All encode strict invariants that fail fast with `throw`/`panic`.

The next batch read five low-level binding/bridge files, four machine-generated: `std/simd/archsimd/other_gen_amd64.go` (SIMD broadcast helpers like `BroadcastInt8x16` under `//go:build goexperiment.simd`), `std/sort/gen_sort_variants.go` (a `//go:build ignore` generator driven by the `Variant` struct), `std/syscall/js/js.go` (`ref` NaN-boxed with `nanHead = 0x7FF80000`, `typeFlag*` constants synced with `wasm_exec.js`), `std/syscall/syscall_darwin.go` (bodyless `Syscall`/`RawSyscall`, `dupTrampoline`, `//sys` directives for mksyscall), and `std/syscall/zsysnum_darwin_amd64.go` (generated `SYS_*` constants).

The most recent batch read five files whole: `std/syscall/zsysnum_linux_mipsle.go`, machine-generated by `mksysnum_linux.pl` from `/usr/include/mips-linux-gnu/asm/unistd.h`, giving `SYS_*` constants starting at 4000 (`SYS_SYSCALL = 4000`, `SYS_EXIT = 4001`, plus unused slots like `SYS_UNUSED18`); `std/syscall/zsysnum_openbsd_arm64.go`, generated by `mksysnum_openbsd.pl`, giving `SYS_*` constants from 1 with the kernel prototypes preserved as trailing comments (`SYS_EXIT = 1 // { void sys_exit(int rval); }`, `SYS_GETENTROPY = 7`); `std/testing/fstest/testfs.go` with `TestFS(fsys fs.FS, expected ...string)` walking the whole tree, checking each file's behavior, verifying symlinks via `fs.ReadLinkFS` when available, requiring at least the listed expected files (an empty expectation means the FS must be empty), recursing into `fs.Sub` per directory prefix, and documenting that the FS must not change concurrently; `std/text/template/funcs.go` with `FuncMap map[string]any` and the `builtins()` function — deliberately not a global so the linker can dead-code eliminate (golang.org/issue/36021) — registering `and`/`call`/`index`/`slice`/`len`/`print`/`printf`, escapers (`html`, `js`, `urlquery`), and comparison funcs `eq`/`ge`/`gt`/`le`/`lt`, where a function's second error return terminates `Execute` and errors wrap for `errors.AsType`; and `std/time/zoneinfo_read.go`, parsing TZif per tzfile(5), with `loadFromEmbeddedTZData` set via `//go:linkname registerLoadFromEmbeddedTZData` from `time/tzdata`, `maxFileSize = 10 << 20`, `fileSizeError`, local `seekStart`/`seekCurrent`/`seekEnd` copies to avoid importing `io`, and `dataIO` with `read`/`big4` that set an error flag on short data.

The conclusion given: all five encode or enforce a precisely specified external contract — the two zsysnum files are generated OS-derived tables mapping `SYS_*` names to integer syscall numbers per platform ABI, `testfs.go` checks an `fs.FS` implementation against the `io/fs` behavioral contract, `funcs.go` validates template function names/signatures and escaping rules, and `zoneinfo_read.go` parses the binary TZif/zip formats strictly per spec. In every case conformance is checked eagerly: out-of-range or malformed input yields a specific error (`errBadData`, "corrupt zip file", "expected but not found", "not a valid identifier") rather than a panic or silent misbehavior. No edits were made.
